basis: Current App² requirements; legacy code contributes selected techniques only. Structural and prompt checks do not certify linguistic quality or learning effectiveness.

requirements.requirement: Numerical story-length quotas retired by PED-004: learner selects narrative scope independently of standardized reading target.
requirements.limitation: Technical output bounds remain active under LANG-004; narrative scope is prompt guidance.

requirements.requirement: Legacy annotations are uniquely aligned for display without changing stored text or guessing ambiguous readings.
